faq: Which analytics tool do you set up?

Google Analytics 4 is the default because it is free and widely used. If you prefer Plausible, Matomo or Shopify's own reports, we can set those up instead and tell you what each one can and cannot show.
Will it work with my store platform?
Yes. We install it on Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix, Squarespace and custom sites, using the platform's own integration where it is reliable and code snippets where it is not.

Only visitors who allow it where the law requires consent. For stores serving the EU, UK or California, add the Privacy and Consent service so tracking waits for permission. Some blockers will hide a share of visits.
Do I own the analytics account?
Always. We create or use a property in your Google account and add our staff email as an editor. When the work ends you can remove us in a few clicks, and nothing is lost.
